serverInfo.description: Ask The Odds Gap sports betting price questions from your AI assistant. Answers come from prices we collect from US sportsbooks and prediction-market exchanges: which book pays the most for a bet, hedge math, parlay prices, a game's full board, past results and line moves. Every answer shows when the prices were scanned and links to the matching page on theoddsgap.com. Prices are a snapshot and may have moved. Information only: it places no bets and gives no picks. 21+. Gambling problem? Call 1-800-GAMBLER.
